endpoints.description: Submit an instantaneous BUY, SELL, SHORT, or COVER market order. Supports standard long buying/selling and two-way short selling: SHORT borrows and sells shares at market price (crediting cash balance with negative quantity), and COVER buys back borrowed shares to realize profit/loss: (Short Price - Cover Price) × Shares. Optional "date" attribute records the market date at which decision was made, used to evaluate bot decision latency without affecting order execution price.
endpoints.pacing: Up to 200 orders/second per team during build and test stage (10-500 orders/second configurable in live simulation), subject to the global API limit.

request_examples.title: BUY (Long Order)
request_examples.description: Buy shares at market price using available cash balance.

request_examples.title: SHORT (Two-Way Short Selling)
request_examples.description: Borrow and sell shares at market price to profit from price declines.

request_examples.title: COVER (Close Short Position)
request_examples.description: Buy back borrowed short shares to realize profit/loss.

request_examples.title: SELL (Close Long Position)
request_examples.description: Sell owned shares to close out an active long holding.

possible_errors.description: Token missing, malformed, or expired.
possible_errors.resolution: Pass Authorization: Bearer <token>. Re-authenticate via POST /api/v1/auth/login if expired.

possible_errors.description: Team account is unverified. Orders cannot be executed until physically approved.
possible_errors.resolution: A team member must visit the organizer registration desk to verify account credentials.

possible_errors.description: Market simulation is currently stopped, idle, or paused. Orders are rejected outside live sessions.
possible_errors.resolution: Wait until the simulation stage is active and market status indicates RUNNING.

possible_errors.description: Order value (Quantity × Price) exceeds the available cash reserve for a BUY or COVER order.
possible_errors.resolution: Reduce purchase quantity or cover existing short positions to free up capital.

possible_errors.description: Attempted to COVER a ticker for which your team holds no open short position (quantity >= 0).
possible_errors.resolution: Query GET /api/v1/portfolio to verify open short positions before submitting COVER orders.

possible_errors.description: Attempted to COVER more shorted shares than currently held.
possible_errors.resolution: Check GET /api/v1/portfolio and submit COVER with quantity <= Math.abs(holding.quantity).

possible_errors.description: Short selling is currently disabled by competition administrators.
possible_errors.resolution: Verify feature flags via GET /api/v1/flags (SHORT_SELLING_ENABLED).

possible_errors.description: The requested ticker symbol is not part of the active market simulation dataset.
possible_errors.resolution: Verify valid active tickers via GET /api/v1/prices or market.ticks stream.

possible_errors.description: Invalid order parameters: quantity must be a positive integer, action must be BUY, SELL, SHORT, SHORT_SELL, or COVER.
possible_errors.resolution: Correct JSON fields: ensure quantity is an integer > 0 and action is one of BUY, SELL, SHORT, SHORT_SELL, COVER.

possible_errors.description: The per-team order rate limit or global API limit was exceeded.
possible_errors.resolution: Throttle trading bot order submission rate and implement exponential backoff.

endpoints.description: Retrieve current cash reserve, open stock holdings (both long and short), mark-to-market valuation, and realized/unrealized P&L. For short positions: quantity is negative, is_short is true, market_value is negative liability (quantity × current_price), and unrealized_pnl is (avg_buy_price - current_price) × |quantity|. Executes with 0ms delay on Order Gateway for high-speed bot execution.

endpoints.description: Retrieve the authenticated list of stocks selected for the active simulation, including during READY and PRE-FLIGHT before the first market tick. Returns each ticker, masked company name, and concise business/product description (<100 words). Bots should fetch this list when pre-flight begins and build their tradable universe from it instead of hard-coding tickers.
endpoints.pacing: Fetch once when pre-flight begins; refresh only if the organizer selects a different simulation.

endpoints.description: Retrieve up to 10 years of historical daily stock price data (OHLCV) for an actively traded ticker symbol. By default, returns daily OHLCV bars strictly prior to the current simulation date (anti-lookahead protection). Supports query parameters ?ticker=<SYMBOL>&start_date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&end_date=<YYYY-MM-DD> (or ?days=<NUM> for a rolling lookback window). If a stock was listed less than 10 years ago or the requested range exceeds its listing date, returns a clear error specifying the listing date.
endpoints.pacing: Fetch on-demand during strategy initialization or periodic technical analysis lookbacks.

request_examples.title: Date Range (start_date & end_date)
request_examples.description: Fetch historical daily prices within an explicit calendar date range (both inclusive).

request_examples.title: Rolling Lookback (days)
request_examples.description: Fetch the most recent N calendar days of daily price bars strictly prior to the current simulation date.

request_examples.title: Start Date Only (start_date)
request_examples.description: Fetch from a specific start date up through the latest available trading date before the current simulation date.

response_examples.title: 200 OK (Historical Prices Found)
response_examples.description: Successfully returns OHLCV records within requested range strictly prior to current simulation date.

response_examples.title: 400 Bad Request (Stock Not Listed in Range)
response_examples.description: Returned when the requested start_date or rolling 10-year window precedes the stock listing/IPO date. Includes the official listing_date so your bot can adjust its start date.

response_examples.description: Returned if end_date includes or exceeds the current simulation date. Future prices are strictly prohibited.
